sources.summary: Cisco Foundation AI has open-sourced FAPO (Fully Automated Prompt Optimization), a Claude Code-driven system that autonomously optimizes multi-step LLM pipelines from baseline prompts to target accuracy. FAPO evaluates a chain, attributes failures at the step level, proposes variants across prompt, parameter, and chain-structure levels, and validates each through an independent reviewer. In Cisco's evaluation, it beat GEPA on 15 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Here's how the optimization loop works and how to run it. The post Cisco AI Introduces FAPO: Pipeline-Aware Prompt Optimization With Step-Level Failure Attribution and Claude Code Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .
